name: LOL: Qui rira le dernier?
summary: Patrick Huard invites 10 comedians to this unique experience that borders on torture. They will spend six hours together in an enclosed space where it is forbidden to laugh. The last one to laugh will win the contest, as well as $100,000 for the foundation of their choice.

name: José Andrés and Family in Spain
summary: Chef José Andrés and his three American-raised daughters, Carlota, Inés, and Lucía Andrés, travel across Spain on an epic gastronomic adventure in José Andrés and Family in Spain. Diving deep into the country's delicious food culture, they visit incredible locations to discover the culinary secrets and traditions of José's homeland.

name: ¡Qué Delicioso!
summary: Contestants from across Latin America put their cultural spin on classic dishes prepared by internationally acclaimed chefs, hoping to win the $10,000 prize that goes to the cook with the best fusion.

name: Jian Wang 3 Wan Hua Xiao Yi Xian
Guyuan Imperial College
summary:
Adapted from the web novel "Niang Zi Zai Shang, Fu Jun Bie Nao" (娘子在上，夫君别闹) by Xiao Zhong Gu Niang (小钟姑娘).
University student Wu Wanwan has accidentally time travelled to a school in ancient times and disguises herself as a man in order to blend in. It follows a series of hilarious stories between Wu Wanwan andd her classmates Tang Wenqi and Qi Shan. Together, they not only fight against inequality over family status but also work towards recruiting female students in a story about integrating modern education concepts into ancient academies.

name: Mr Charity
summary: Sitcom focusing on international aid charity HELP and its less-than-charitable, egotistical managing director, Graham Templeton.

name: Los Dos Bros
summary: Features Darren Boyd and Cavan Clerkin, a pair of dysfunctional half-brothers are forced to explore their recurring sibling rivalries.

name: Los Luchadores
summary: Action comedy show about three young heroic Canadian luchadores fighting supervillains.

name: Make My Day
summary: On a cold planet of ice and snow, mysterious creatures suddenly have appeared from the dark underground and have begun to attack the inhabitants. Can humanity survive the terror lurking beyond the horizon?

name: Les Visiteurs
summary: In France, one day in 1980, the Parisian mechanic Jean-Louis Brozec was the victim of a motorcycle accident. At the same time, in Germany, Renate Matiessen, daughter of a billionaire, died after falling from a horse. But both come back to life very quickly and end up finding themselves in Paris, even though they were previously unaware of the existence of each other.

name: Huck
summary: Huck uses his special gifts to do good deeds, but when his secret is revealed, he winds up on a life-changing adventure.

name: Пес Патрон
summary: The main character of the animated series is Patron the dog, who, as in real life, is engaged in the search for explosive objects. The hero experiences various adventures with his friend, Tom the cat, and Ukrainian animals, who have become popular for their brave deeds.

name: Wonderful Hand
summary: In the late 20th century, lives a skillful and courageous doctor named Lin Hao. Along with his passionate and easygoing boss Wu Renyao, understanding and kind nurse Wu Ruolan, they operate a medical hall at the border of Hui Zhou Town. He also forms a friendship with Zeng Fan, who just returned from studying medicine overseas; as well as He Xinxin, a straightforward girl who works at the martial arts art house. As the group of people work together to cure patients, a mysterious case surfaced which links to the death of Lin Hao's parents. Lin Hao decides to investigate the truth, and the perpetrator turns out to be none other than the father of someone he trusts...

name: Zoo Quest
summary: David Attenborough and a team from London Zoo travel in search of exotic animals. Their aim is to capture them and bring them back to the UK for exhibit in the zoo.

name: Small Town Potential
summary: Cameras will chronicle the rich history of New York's scenic Hudson Valley region, while showcasing a modern-day design business in Small Town Potential. Life and work partners Davina Thomasula and Kristin Leitheuser, along with Kristin's dad Don Leitheuser, will help their clients find, buy and renovate unique properties that have astounding potential. Davina, a real estate agent with a flare for design, Kristin, a builder with expert construction know-how, and Don, a skilled master carpenter, aren't afraid to take on full-scale renovations that will transform small-town houses into

name: UniteUp!
summary: Akira Kiyose, a high schooler who loves to sing, gets recruited by a talent agency called sMiLea Production. Akira learns that the legendary idols "Anela," who shocked the world with their sudden retirement, are behind the agency developing talent. Together with Banri Naoe and Chihiro Isuzugawa, also recruited by the agency, they form an idol group as they chase their dream towards super stardom alongside other idol groups "LEGIT" and "JAXX/JAXX."

name: Piste noire
summary: In the Alps, the resort of Les Clairies celebrates the victory of its downhill champion, Boris Arnoux, darling of the country. The party is in full swing when a fire breaks out further down the valley, in a makeshift camp. A caravan burns, enclosing in its flames a poorly housed seasonal worker. This "accident" is the starting point of an investigation led by Emilie Karras, a young policeman from Lyon, originally from Les Clairies where she grew up but whom she also left 12 years ago to save herself. She is forced to stay and collaborate with Major Servoz, a disillusioned local policeman. They will discover the twists and turns of this resort swallowed up by a luxurious real estate project that divides people as much as it stares at the mountain.

name: In Spite of the Strong Wind
summary: When Tang Chen's career was booming, he had to declare bankruptcy when he was "selled" by his girlfriend Shuo Bing. But soon he withdrew from the swamp of failure and actively devoted himself to the second venture. Sha Zhou, a good friend for many years, has an excellent writing style, but he has always been a depressed little reporter. With the persuasion of Tang Chen and the support of his wife, he was the first to join the entrepreneurial team. According to the division of labor within the team, Tang Chen and Sha Zhou worked together to find Hou Zhi, Zhu Ran, and Bai Ying, and set up a gray whale public relations company. Tang Chen used his industry acumen for many years to actively search for customers, lead his partners to overcome difficulties, help pig feed magnate Xie Liqiang to build a public image, push the furious divine comedy, and win Feida's public relations contract. However, in a confrontation with a competing company, Tang Chen discovered an unknown secret between Shuo Bing and Ye Shou Ru. With the concern of another identity, Tang Chen and Shuo Bing fell in love and killed each other, and after a few games, they finally understood Shuo Bing's seemingly ruthless choice. In the end, the two teamed up to punish Ye Shou Ru, the culprit who caused Shuo Bing's father to commit suicide, and got back together. Every member of Grey Whale PR also realized their own value.

name: Між крапельками
summary: The documentary series Між крапельками tells about how Ukrainian culture survived in the Soviet Union.  In those dark times, a creative approach to censorship helped to circumvent and defeat it.  Fortunately, not all pro-Ukrainian citizens were imprisoned in camps and mental institutions.  There were many professionals who studied the rules of the game and preserved Ukrainian between drops.

name: Культові українці. Позначені гривнею
summary: The historical program Культові українці. Позначені гривнею tells about unknown stories about outstanding personalities of Ukraine. The host of the program Yelyzaveta Tsarehradska and the co-host, historian Oleksandr Alforov will tell little-known facts from the biographies of the figures depicted on the hryvnia banknotes without complicated terms.

name: Walkin' Hame
summary: Mark Thompson and Lolly Spence explore the 300-mile Ulster leg of the International Appalachian Trail, all the way from the coastal town of Larne to Donegal.

name: Maria Clara at Ibarra
summary:
Klay is a young woman who is excited to graduate from the university so she can work abroad. However, she must pass her back subject, Rizal Studies, in order to graduate.

Klay wakes up one morning and finds herself in the world of Jose Rizal's novel, Noli Me Tangere. She desperately tries to return to the present but she can only do so after she finishes the story and learns her lesson.

She meets the lovers in the Novel, Maria Clara, and Crisostomo Ibarra. The characters teach Klay the value of history, empathy, patriotism, and love.

Soon, Klay falls in love with Ibarra and decides to stay in his world in order to save the novel's characters.

name: Sisterhood
summary: Fang's youngest daughter Xiang Xiang has just entered the society after graduating from university. Her elder sister Fang Hong believes that "eldest sister is like a mother", and regardless of Fang's feelings, she is enthusiastically involved in her sister's work and life. The two sisters with very different personalities and concepts constantly rubbed and collided, making this originally harmonious and intimate family in the smoke of the sisters' quarrel and quarrel all day long. Father Fang Ming was in a dilemma. He spent most of his life living for his daughters, but as his daughters became more mature and independent, Fang Ming felt that he was less and less needed. So Fang Ming began to try to find a sense of existence in his daughters' minds.

name: Stacey Dooley Sleeps Over USA
summary: Stacey meets a variety of extraordinary families in the USA, lifting the lid on more fascinating and unusual lifestyles.

name: Insect Totem
summary:
Adapted from the novel "Chong Tu Teng" (虫图腾) by Yan Zhi Yang (闫志洋).
Pan Jun, a descendant of a famous physician from Chong Cao Medical Hall, meets the descendant hailing from the five great families from the Chong tribe. Together, they discover a trail leading to the hidden treasures of the Chong tribe. On their journey to retrieve these treasures, they undergo various adventures which leads them to discover the secrets behind these treasures dating back twenty years ago.

name: Obituary
summary: Six-part series about an obituarist working at a small-town newspaper, who suddenly finds herself being paid by the obituary due to cuts. When she "accidentally" kills a nasty piece of work, she discovers she might have an untapped bloodlust, and sets her sights on other unpleasant residents of the town. Her killing spree hits a potential snag when the paper hires an attractive crime correspondent.

name: The Edinburgh Auction House
summary: Auctioneer Sybelle Thomson delves through homes in Scotland in search of items she thinks will deliver the goods at auction.

name: Nokemono-tachi no Yoru
summary: Wisteria is an orphan girl living in a corner of the British Empire at the end of the 19th century. Her life is desolate and bleak–until she encounters Marbas, a powerful but equally lonely immortal being with a furry appearance, hounded by hunters. Together, Wisteria and Marbas roam the Empire–populated by humans and human-like beasts–in search of a place where they can live together in peace.

previousepisode.name: You mean the world to me

name: Les rencontres du Papotin
summary: France 2 presents Les rencontres du Papotin. This new atypical interview magazine takes up the DNA of the newspaper Le Papotin, whose editorial staff (40 to 50 young people) is made up of journalists, non-professionals, with autism spectrum disorder. In each episode, a unique personality is interviewed without filter and without a star presenter. During this meeting, the rules of the game are simple: "you can tell Papotin anything, but, above all, anything can happen!"

name: This Sitcom Is... Not to Be Repeated
24Seven
summary: 24Seven focused on a group of students living at Discovery House, a dorm at the Oaks Boarding School.

name: Curious Traveler
summary: Journalist Christine van Blokland takes you to the most intriguing places in the world, to explore the mysteries of each destination's art, architecture and hidden histories. Each episode begins with a list of Curious Questions that will be answered in the episode, such as: Why are there so many French chateaux in the Loire Valley? Is Rome's Pantheon really an ancient sun dial? Why do Viking ships look different than Venetian gondolas? And why is there a floating church off the coast of Montenegro?

name: Pelé: Long Live the King
summary: A look back at stellar career of the footballing legend and three-time World Cup winner, who passed away at the age of 82.

name: Catch Up My Prince
summary:
Adapted from the game Zhe Keng Die De You Xi (这坑爹的XX游戏).
Interning doctor Lu Ran Ran and game designer Wang Chen Yi accidentally enter the virtual reality game he designed for his sister and together they experienced the strange unfolding of events of the imaginative and mysterious world Wang Chen Yi created.

name: Конфетка
summary: The participants of the program will be amateur musicians who dream of a big stage, but are so far known only in narrow Internet circles. The authors of the show will help them turn their songs into a real "candy". Each song will get a new breath thanks to the stars who will perform them in a new arrangement right in the studio. Five nuggets and five stars will take part in each issue: experts will evaluate their performances, and the audience in the hall will choose the winner, who will receive a cash prize.

name: Romance with Blind Master
summary: Ruan Qingtian's stepmother secretly signed a contract for her to become an assistant to an aloof CEO, Ren Haoming. What's worse, this president is also a blind man with a horrible temper; what's even worse, Ruan Qingtian has a deep-rooted history with this man! Ruan Qingtian is forced to stay by Ren Haoming's side to be tortured by him! However, the gods of fate favored the kind-hearted Ruan Qingtian, and over time, Ren Haoming and her fell in love. Although, when Ren Haoming finally recovered his eyesight through surgery and looked for Ruan Qingtian to get married, Ruan Qingtian was switched by his sister Ruan Xinxin, and as a result, Ren Hao Ming and Ruan Xinxin got engaged instead. Ruan Qingtian can only secretly care for Ren Haoming, but to Ren Haoming she's but a vixen...

name: Angel
summary: Angel, a teen who is determined to escape her abusive guardian Teresa. Angel warms the hearts of viewers as she humbly steps up to care for her three foster sisters Sheree, Milk and Rain. Angel finds herself in the concrete jungle surrounded by animals. Diamond and Dutch attempt to show Angel the ways of the streets, but her arrogance and lack of experience gets in her way. With no money, nowhere to live and pursued by Detective Monroe, Angel's only choice is to become a beast.

name: Xcalibur
summary: King Edwin, ruler of a medieval-like Kingdom is assassinated by his brother and regent, Bragan, who has made a truce with the evil warlock, Kwodahn. The murder is witnessed by Prince Erwann who carries out the dying King's final orders; to take Xcalibur and hide it in a safe place. After hiding the sword, Kwodahn curses Erwann, turning him to stone. Erwann's feisty teenage daughter, Princess Djana befriends Herik, a young apprentice of the exiled Shogis, a sect of sorcerers, who has been entrusted with the Book of Life, the collected knowledge of the Shogis. Together, they retrieve Xcalibur, however upon reaching the Royal Palace, they learn Bragan has taken control of the Kingdom as regent to Arthus, the 10-year-old sovereign, too young to rule himself, and confiscated Prince Erwann's lands as his own, falsely branding him as the assassin.

name: Seeking Brother Husband
summary: Follow four polyandrous relationships in various stages and their quests for more love. Seeking Brother Husband documents the ups and downs of adding additional husbands into family life and everything that happens in between as couples navigate boundaries and life-changing decisions.

name: Choice Husband
summary:
Adapted from the novel "Liang Zhi Qian Fu Yi Tai Xi" (两只前夫一台戏) by Dian Xian (电线).
Shen Mia is the daughter of the wealthiest man in Yangzhou City. Although she has wealth and beauty, no one dares marry her. Potential grooms consider her jinxed since two former fiancés ran away before their weddings. Shen Miao will meet a talented young scholar named Pei Yan Zhen, beginning a fantastic love story.

name: Jet Lag: The Game
summary: We play games where the world is our board. Jet Lag: The Game is an online reality competition centered around travel. In it, players travel to various locations to complete challenges, helping them towards a larger goal - either by claiming territory or replenishing their travel budget. With the world as the "board," each season is a unique game.

name: Bridge of Lies Celebrity Specials
summary: Teams of celebrities take on the nail-biting quiz hosted by Ross Kemp.

previousepisode.name: Rosie Jones, Ed Byrne, Nabil Abdulrashid, Harriet Kemsley

name: Genombrottet
summary: When a shocking double homicide goes unsolved for 16 years, a detective teams up with a genealogist to catch the killer before it becomes a cold case.

name: La Rebelión
summary: Four women decide to leave their homes unexpectedly without telling anyone their whereabouts, to rebel against their marriages and their lives as housewives that did not turn out as they thought. However, in addition to the trip, a murder will bring their lives together.

name: Taiwan Crime Stories
summary: A four-part anthology series inspired by real-life Taiwan crime cases, including a train derailment insurance fraud case, a family annihilation case, a murder case of an elementary school teacher, and a child homicide on a military base.

name: Mrs Sidhu Investigates
summary: Mrs. Sidhu is a high-end caterer with a taste for crime. Recently widowed, she juggles her new catering business with encouraging her wayward son Tez to find his passion, all while serving up justice to those who believe they are above the law. Her forays into sleuthing see her form an unofficial partnership with long-suffering divorcee DCI Burton who reluctantly accepts that together they're an unbeatable crime-fighting duo, much to the bemusement of his partner, DS Mint.

name: Judge Me Not
summary: Judge Me Not is the story of Zelma Jay Johnson, an unusually bright, young black woman who struggles with mental health issues, a ludicrous family, and volatile love life. We join her as she takes on her new role as a judge in a court full of outrageous characters both in front of and behind the bench. As her passionate relationship with her live-in lover takes them both on a ride, she finds herself caught in the crosshairs a psychological thriller that puts her life at risk.

name: The Forgotten Realms
summary: The Forgotten Realms takes place in the iconic campaign setting and centerpiece of the Dungeons & Dragons universe, Hasbro's wildly popular fantasy role-playing game franchise.

name: Taçsız Prenses
summary: Masal, who grew up with the tales of her dreamy mother, Şirin, is trapped in a cold and realistic world when her mother is hospitalized due to heart disease. As a result, she turns into a fierce, vicious girl who can do anything. The first person Masal will receive support from is her teacher Evgin, and things will turn around for everyone over time. On Masal's journey, she will complete the unfinished tales of the other heroes of the story one by one while searching for her own tale, and on this journey, the closest person to Masal will be her dog Köfte, who never leaves her side...

name: Dokuz Oğuz
summary: Colonel Tomris Toprak establishes the "Turkish World Emergency Response Team" to fight for persecuted Turks, but the evil centers are determined to strangle it.

name: Chasing Waves
summary: In the wake of surfing's Olympic debut in Tokyo, Chasing Waves shines a spotlight on the people and places that are defining Japan's reach in the global surf culture. This character-driven documentary series follows multicultural athletes in pursuit of their dreams, paints a captivating picture of Japanese life and showcases what it takes to succeed in the international surf industry.

name: Earth Abides
summary:
When a plague of unprecedented virulence sweeps the globe, the human race is all but wiped out. In the aftermath, as the great machine of civilization slowly and inexorably breaks down, only a few shattered survivors remain to struggle against the slide into barbarism... or extinction.

Earth Abides is a limited series adaptation of George R. Stewart's classic sci-fi novel of the same name.

name: American Classic
summary: American Classic is a comedy about a man desperately trying to save himself, his family, and his hometown in the only way he knows how—by putting on a show. Broadway star and notorious narcissist Richard Bean suffers a spectacular public meltdown, and decides to return home to the family-run theater where he first became aware of his own brilliance. When he arrives, he's shocked to find that his brother, and his brother's wife (who also happens to be his former lover), have turned his temple of art into a dinner theater—with the emphasis on dinner.

name: Ark
summary: It's 2030, the oceans have risen rapidly, and soon, the entire planet will be submerged. But the discovery of another life-sustaining planet light-years away gives hope to those who remain alive. Only a few will be able to make the generations-long journey, and those who don't make the cut face a watery death.

name: Omega - The Gift and The Curse
summary: Featuring singer-songwriter Omarion, this new docu-series goes beyond the veil of what it's like to live under the celebrity microscope and gives fans an exclusive look on what it's like to succeed, transition, rebuild, and evolve into your own man. The docu-series takes fans behind the scenes with exclusive never-before-seen interviews, rehearsals, tour footage and performances across the U.S. from one of the biggest Reunion Tours.

name: Grown & Gospel
summary: A docu-series about a group of successful millennial friends who are the offspring of Gospel legends based in the city of Detroit. These "kids" are now grown and ready to shake up all the norms of their Gospel roots. Each Gospel star has made their unique mark on the music scene, but they also each have very dark secrets and personal conflicts that may undermine their efforts to revolutionize the Gospel music industry.

name: Roast Battle Le Grand Duel
summary: In this competition animated by Alexandre Barrette (seasons 1 to 3) and by Ève Côté (season 4), comedians compete in a merciless verbal contest. The goal: to determine who is the funniest by making fun of his opponent. In front of an audience, comedians must demonstrate their ability to break their competitor.

name: The Brave Fighter of Sun Fighbird
summary: Draias, the self-declared ruler of the universe decided to make Earth his base. Together with his ever-loyal subjects Zol and Shura, he carries out his misdeeds through the evil scientist Jango. To stop them, Fighbird and his team follow him to Earth. Fighbird disguises himself as Prof. Amano's assistant, Katori Yutaro, and in doing so, is in for a culture shock as he learns how to live with his human hosts. It's the good, old, cliched battle of good-versus-evil on a mainly human scale as Prof. Amano settles a lifelong grudge match against his former colleague Dr. Jango, while Fighbird squares of with Draias and his men.

name: O Crime do Padre Amaro
summary: Based on the romance of one of the most prestigious authors of Portuguese literature, Eça de Queiroz, the series follows the story of the forbidden passion between Amaro, a young priest, and Amélia "the most beautiful girl in town". Tense, emotional and anchored in personality conflicts, the series takes a critical look at society and the church in Portugal, in the 19th century.

name: DROП
summary: DROP is a web series about you: a story not about pretentious children of rich parents from the capital's lyceum. We will not tell an action-packed fantasy drama written by screenwriters specifically for the effect. Our heroes are your friends. So ordinary, simple and soulful. Real. You see them every day, they walk down the street next to you. The plot of the series DROP is based on real events. The first season will consist of 8 episodes, 4 main characters. Each character will have 2 episodes in which he will tell the story with his own eyes.

name: India: The Modi Question
summary: Investigating tensions between Indian PM Narendra Modi and the country's Muslim minority.

name: Full Swing
summary: Pull back the curtain and witness what it takes to be a champion in professional golf, where a single shot can make a week, a season — or even a career.

name: Jeopardy! Masters
summary: Hosted by the "GOAT" Ken Jennings, Jeopardy! Masters is latest iteration of America's Favorite Quiz Show, showcasing the six highest-ranked current Jeopardy! contestants.

name: Love Trip: Paris
summary: The series, which is set entirely in Paris, follows four American women who have been unlucky in love in their own country and move into a penthouse in the middle of Paris to find a floor of French suitors waiting to date them. Is this love trip to Paris their one-way ticket to romance, or are they headed for heartbreak in another language?

name: The Righteous Apples
summary: PBS's first domestically-produced situation comedy series revolved around a multi-ethnic group of five Boston students from Sherwin High – three black and two white – who have formed a rock group: Samuel ‘DC' Rosencrantz; Sandy Burns ; Charles ‘Big Neck' McMorris; Glorette Benson and JT.

name: Кот Басик
summary: A very ordinary young programmer has a very unusual cat named Basik. He is endowed with supernatural intelligence. However, this does not surprise anyone. In the modern world, it is not customary to be surprised. And in vain! After all, Basik is a truly amazing cat. He is smart, reserved, caring and, what's more, a real gentleman. His funny adventures and cunning tricks will surprise and amuse not only the owner, but also the audience!

name: Archie's Funhouse
summary: Archie appears on stage in front of a theater full of (live-action) kids each week and introduces his Fun House and the star of the show, the Giant Jukebox. The Archie gang gives its audience crazy blackout gags, outrageous puns and wacky jokes. The regular segments are "How to Catch a Man" with Big Ethel, "Thunderbolt Theatre" and "Giant Jukebox Jokes." Semi-regular features include "The Early Early Show," "Betty's Diary," "The Big, Big World of Sports" with Coach Cleats, an inept trapeze act with Reggie and Moose; and more. Each episode has three songs performed by The Archies.

name: Carina Bergfeldt
summary: Talk show with the journalist and author Carina Bergfeldt. Guests with exciting stories are interviewed by the TV profile that the audience has come to know as SVT's USA correspondent.

name: Cyklopernas land
summary: Follow Some of the country's smartest cultural minds tackle big and small issues from the past week. There will be fun talk, sharp exchanges, intellectual deep dives and a lot of completely normal nonsense.

name: Stjärnorna på slottet
summary: Follow five popular stars as they live together for a week

name: À coeur battant
summary: À coeur battant takes us into individual stories, but at the same time, they concern the whole family and society. These stories will allow us to better understand the dynamics of violence, to also measure the extent to which we live in a culture of violence where everyone in our families does not take enough measure of it. Are we too tolerant of violent words, looks, attitudes, gestures and controlling habits?

name: Avec Moi
summary: Rosie, a 16-year-old YouTuber, has to deal with the struggles of adolescence and her newfound popularity on social media. Caught between her desire to please and the hateful criticism she receives, she loses her authenticity. His personal relationships deteriorate rapidly. Her best friend reproaches her for abandoning her and her lover becomes more and more possessive.

name: Natural Born Narco
summary: Chronicles the origins of notorious real-life drug lord Amado Carrillo Fuentes, inspired in the acclaimed telenovela.

name: Praise Petey
summary: The series follows Petey, a New York City "it" girl who has it all until her life comes crashing down around her. As luck would have it, a mysterious gift from her father gives her a new lease on life: she's going to "lean into" modernizing his small-town cult.

name: Exploding Kittens
summary: It's the ultimate fight between good and evil when God and his nemesis, the spawn of Satan, are sent to Earth to live with humans — as talking cats.

name: The Exchange
summary: Inspired by real events, two women set out to pioneer the cutthroat stock market of 1980s Kuwait - and disrupt its corrupt boys club along the way. Welcome to 80s Kuwait... the heyday of the stock market. Two Kuwaiti women are about to blaze a trail to become "Wonders of The Exchange", in a male-dominated workplace, where bets are bold, and stakes are sky-high!

name: The Makery
summary: Join Nim and her friend The Makery - an extraordinary talking funhouse full of amazing arts and crafts, brilliant bakes and inspiring ideas for those old cardboard boxes!

name: Britain's Notorious Prisons
summary:
Britain's Notorious Prisons reveals the reality of life behind the walls of two of the UK's most infamous prisons, Strangeways and Wormwood Scrubs.

Manchester's Strangeways and London's Wormwood Scrubs have housed some of the country's most dangerous convicts, including serial killers, rapists and paedophiles.

Featuring exclusive first-hand testimony from past inmates and staff, this two-part series for ITV and ITVX uncovers what really goes on behind the famous prison gates, uncovering the drug abuse, violence and some of the biggest events in both prisons' histories. 

The two-part series highlights the past behaviour of some prison officers and the abuse of power, which had a detrimental impact on the running of the prisons and added to the hostile environments that prisoners became accustomed to. 

The programmes investigate a vast array of issues impacting the prisons including the overt racism in the seventies and eighties in Strangeways, extreme prisoner violence in Wormwood Scrubs, and the potential long lasting impact of covid on the prison system.

As we hear from those who lived and breathed the prisons over the decades, the raw, uncut stories need to be seen to be believed, as the shocking truth is explained and interrogated.

name: Hotell Romantik
summary: 28 singles are looking for the right one at the beautiful alpine hotel where everyone is over 65. The schedule includes adventurous activities and each evening ends with dinner and dancing - then the couple of the evening is also chosen, who gets an overnight stay in a romantic cabin.

name: Min Sanning
summary: In-depth conversations with famous Swedes.

name: Din Hjärna
summary: Läkaren Anders Hansen tar hjälp av experter, experiment och forskning för att svara på hur och varför vår hjärna fungerar som den gör.

name: Vintermästarna
summary: Vintermästarna är programmet där idrottsprofiler, stjärnor och sportjournalister gör upp om vem som kan allra mest om vintersport. En rolig, spännande och prestigefylld frågesport för alla som älskar Vinterstudion!

name: Stockholms Gängkrig Bakom Rubrikerna
summary: I den här serien möter vi de människor som berörs av konflikterna bland gängen: unga kriminella, anhöriga till offren, poliser och åklagare, frivilligorganisationerna och de boende som försöker rädda sitt område. Varför skjuter pojkar och unga män ihjäl varandra i Sverige? Och hur vi ska kunna stoppa våldet på våra gator?

name: Draknästet Vad Hände Sen
summary: Tillbakablickar och återträffar med de mest minnesvärda entreprenörerna från Draknästet sedan starten 2010.

previousepisode.name: "Vi vill bygga en unicorn - ett bolag som är värt 1 miljard"

name: Fejk
summary: Tre tjejers öden flätas samman kring en dramatisk händelse som leder till en persons försvinnande. Ett år senare påverkar detta fortfarande alla och riskerar att rasera både vänskap, kärlek och karriär för de inblandade.

previousepisode.name: Ska du skjuta oss en efter en?

name: Vaietut arktiset sodat
summary: The Silent Arctic Wars is a new generation historical documentary series that opens up the Arctic war events of World War II in a never-before-seen way. The six episodes of the series reveal a little-noticed overall picture and countless unknown details about the events of World War II in the North. The focus is on the struggle of the great powers over who gets control of the region and its natural resources. New information and perspectives on the events are offered by numerous international experts, ongoing field research, as well as newly opened archives and some never-before-seen footage.

name: Tere Bin
summary:
Meerab is an ambitious and beautiful young girl who wants to pursue higher studies. Her entire world revolves around her parents and she believes in them the most. Her strong and confident personality makes her stand against social injustices around her.

On the contrary, Murtasim hails from a powerful and influential family. He respects and values the morals and traditions of his family and refuses to let the family down.

Meerab's life takes an unexpected turn when she finds out about her family's decision regarding her and Murtasim's life. Meerab's hatred towards Murtasim continues to grow as a family secret from the past resurfaces. Coming from different backgrounds and mindsets, Murtasim begins to realize Meerab's arrogant behaviour towards him and begins to consider her a challenge for himself. On the other hand, Meerab who is used to living her life on her own terms refuses to accept Murtasim's family traditions and unnecessary social barriers.

Soon their lives go through a series of emotional sufferings and misunderstandings where it becomes difficult for them to coexist. Despite their hatred towards each other, will Meerab and Murtasim accept their true feelings or will the dynamics of ego and self-respect force them to stay apart?

name: Gestern waren wir noch Kinder
summary: The Klettmann family lives in a posh suburb of Munich and doesn't seem to have any financial problems. Peter Klettmann is a successful lawyer, his wife Anna takes care of their children Vivian, Daniel and Emma. Family life seems perfect, but on Anna's 44th birthday the world suddenly collapses: In a fit of anger, Peter kills his wife.

name: Irish Pickers
summary: Irish Pickers follows Dublin-based antiques expert and historical dealer Ian Dowling, with his team comprising of Mark ‘Butzy' Butterly, ‘Vintage' Vinny Smith and Ali Foy as they discover, buy and sell Irish treasures.

name: The Chemistry of Death
summary: Following a personal tragedy, forensic anthropologist Dr. David Hunter left his career as a police consultant and settled down as a general practitioner in a small town in Norfolk, England. When a murder occurs there, in which a severely mutilated woman's body is found, the local police turn to him with a request for help. Hunter has reservations about getting involved. When a second woman is murdered, the townsfolk tear each other up with suspicions - and "newcomer" Hunter is also blamed.

name: Secret Woman
summary: A drama about a woman who loses her sight due to her husband and his lover and falls into 'Locked-In Syndrome' (conscious general paralysis) getting involved with an heiress who has everything and comes out for truth and revenge.

name: The Knockout
summary: After 20 years of perseverance, the passionate young man eventually became the people's hero.

name: My Uncanny Destiny
summary: For generations the two cities of Mu Xi and Xuanyue have fought each other, always trying to conquer the other. The old city owner of Mu Xi had only one daughter, Ye Zhaonan, whose gender he secretly concealed so she could one day inherit. From an early age Zhaonan was always disguised as a boy, until one day when Ye Zhaonan fell off the cliff and met Liu Xuanming, the lord of Xuanyue City, and started a wonderful destiny.

name: Pongwiffy
summary: Pongwiffy revolves around a witch, Pongwiffy, and her dysfunctional group of friends.

name: How to Live to 100
summary: Jon Snow travels the world visiting communities where residents are living longer and healthier lives, with lower rates of fatal diseases and extra years of good health in old age.

name: Know Your Sh!t
summary: Alana Macfarlane-Kempner and Lisa Macfarlane talk to experts at Poo HQ about different issues members of the public are having with their gut health.

previousepisode.name: Married ... with Children: Weenie Tot Lovers & Other Strangers / Bewitched: A Bunny For Tabitha

name: Bespoke Inns
summary: Innkeepers share the stories behind the creation, renovation and design of America's most enchanting boutique inns.

name: Ateş Kuşları
summary: Most street children do not reach the age of twenty. It cannot be said that those who saw it lived. Drugs, violence, sexual harassment, hunger... The fate of street children is either prison or grave. Five of these children manage to resist this fate. Calling themselves "Rootless"; The Firebirds, the oldest of which is 13, the youngest is 6 years old, one girl and one autistic, five street children who find a forty-day-old baby in a garbage dump and tell how they turned from "Rootless" to "Firebirds"; will cover the stories of children resisting hardship, pain and fate against all odds.

name: Détox
summary: Realizing they both have a toxic relationship to the Internet, roommates Léa and Manon decide to do the unthinkable: abandon all devices for 30 days.

name: Artfully Designed
summary: Designer Natalie Papier, muralist Racheal Jackson and abstract artist Frankie Zombie take an art-forward approach to creating beautifully curated spaces for their clients by exploring the intersection of art and interior design.

previousepisode.name: Lakeside Living Room: Bringing Outside Beauty In

name: The Piece Maker
summary: Painter and puzzle maker Eric Dowdle travels around the world to learn from locals and experience environments firsthand. Each story and place he encounters becomes a piece of a new puzzle he creates.

name: Second Wife
summary: A romantic dramedy about the ups and downs of a blended family. Fresh off a terrible breakup, Sasha flees her life in New York to start over in London, where she meets and quickly falls in love with a recently divorced father named Jacob. When they impulsively decide to get married, they will soon learn that there's a lot they don't know about each other – and they can't outrun their pasts forever. Darkly comedic in tone, Second Wife is an exploration of intimacy, failure, and second chances.

name: Brave Police J-Decker
summary: After stumbling upon a secret laboratory, Yuuta Tomonaga made a habit of sneaking inside after hours to spend time with his new friend: Deckerd, a giant mecha being developed for the Japanese Police. Over the past six months, Yuuta has taught Deckerd concepts which he was never meant to understand; things like joy, anger, sadness, and having a "heart". But now Deckerd is ready for Police service and his reprogramming will in all likelihood obliterate this knowledge...

name: Kashokhin
summary: A fuel smuggler in southern Iran, who has been reprimanded and criticized by the others after the death of his comrade in a car accident, embarks on a one-man journey to seek revenge after finding clues to his comrade's murder.

name: Made in Finland
summary: Based on true events, Made in Finland is a drama series about the close calls and the uncertain first steps of a small Finnish electronics company becoming a global titan of the mobile phone industry.

name: Открытый брак
summary: A married couple well over 40, married for 20 years, three children. Faced with the crisis of such a long, albeit happy relationship, they come to an agreement - to live in the format of an open marriage. Now they meet with other people, trying to figure out whether it is possible to become happy and not lose a loved one.

name: Раневская
summary: Despite the prohibition of her parents, 20-year-old Faina Feldman is going to conquer theatrical Moscow. The capital greets her with hostility, but Faina does not care much, especially since real friends and mentors appear in her life who teach, help, and patronize. Every little success is replaced by a serious life drama. A revolution, then a war... and every time - a serious struggle for life, which rests on a fragile hope, great love for the theater and absolute faith in one's own destiny.

name: Разрешите обратиться
summary: Detective Gosha Kotov since childhood dreams of being as cool as his legendary father, who died in the line of duty back in the nineties. But for him to succeed, a miracle must happen. At first, Gosha is not very good at catching criminals, because he is a coward, but by the will of circumstances, Gosha is bitten by an infected dog: the guy acquires superpowers and becomes a werewolf - incredibly strong and dexterous, with a heightened sense of smell and hearing. But what remains unchanged in Gaucher is his keen sense of justice. From that moment on, Gosha begins to actively fight crime, as well as solve his personal problems. And the more he uses his newfound power, the more he becomes its hostage. Gaucher will have to pass the test of power, win love and realize that great power comes with great responsibility.

name: Очевидное невероятное
summary: The most ordinary at first glance, the provincial town of Veliky Guslyar is, in fact, a unique point on the planet Earth, where communication with parallel worlds and civilizations of other planets is open. Time travel, teleportation, talking animals and flying saucer parking are commonplace for the locals. The Guslyars are so accustomed to them that they practically do not notice.

name: Кибердеревня
summary: Nikolai lives with his family in a cybervillage on Mars. He calmly runs a robotic economy until the head of a large corporation arrives on the planet, who wants to build a new factory on the site of the village.

name: Дело о пропавшей деревне
summary: In search of sensational material for her blog, metropolitan journalist Tatyana Blok ends up in the Russian village of Nizhniye Brody. The reason for shooting is large-scale: one morning in the village of Upper Brody (across the river from the Lower) all the people disappeared. Together, twenty people. Money, documents, and all livestock remained in place. People seem to have evaporated in an instant. Tatyana takes over the investigation. For her, this is a chance to prove to everyone that she was fired from television for nothing and that she is capable of making high-quality investigative reports. Cultural and everyday differences between locals and visitors will become the main source of a large number of curious situations. The heroine will have to learn to live in the village, or rather, to survive in it.

name: Цербер
summary: 1826, St. Petersburg. After the suppression of speeches on the Senate Square, the investigative commission begins searching for participants in the Decembrist uprising. Some of them are caught by the authorities because of informers. Suddenly, a series of brutal murders takes place in St. Petersburg: the victims are those who denounced the Decembrists. A piece of paper with lines from a poem by the young poet Alexander Pushkin invariably remains near the bodies of the murdered. A Moscow detective and a nobleman Alexander Boshnyak, released from arrest, are taking over the investigation of the case.

name: Волшебный участок
summary: Leha, a former police sniper with post-traumatic stress disorder, learns about his sister Katya's terminal illness in the midst of an alcoholic binge. Katya does not want her daughter to be sent to an orphanage after her death, and asks Lech to take hold of her head so that he becomes the guardian of an eight-year-old girl. Lech has already lost many close people in his life, so he does everything to help his sister: he gathers old connections and gets a job at the police station. The area turns out to be difficult. The criminals that Lech must catch are fairy—tale characters: Serpent Gorynych, Baba Yaga and other evil spirits. And if the former sniper has no problems catching villains, then trying to become a good guardian becomes a real test for Lehi.

name: Сансара
summary: After celebrating his own thirty-fifth birthday, time for Andrey begins to go in the opposite direction: each new day is the previous one for him. To return to the real time, Andrei needs to find the mistakes he made in the past and correct them. He does not understand how to do this, believing that he did not have any mistakes in the past.

name: Кеша должен умереть
summary: Innokenty Melnikov, a charismatic and successful architect, who has three marriages behind him, remains, despite divorces, the main person in the life of his women - Lena, Yulia and Vari. Kesha not only continues to actively support them and communicate closely with them, but also secretly maintains a sexual relationship. However, the symbiosis convenient for everyone begins to collapse after the man becomes interested in Alla, a girl from a completely different "circle". Now the offended ladies jokingly offer to get rid of him.

name: Бэби-тур
summary: 2009, a small Russian village of Livni. Lively and purposeful Zinaida walks from door to door, not very successful in selling cosmetics, and on one of these visits she learns that there is a way to change life. If you give birth to a child in the United States, he will become an American who will be able to transport all his relatives abroad. Zinaida incites her friends who work at a local poultry farm to get pregnant urgently and fly to the States. But the men are against it. Realizing that there is nowhere to wait for help, the girlfriends are looking for additional earnings, which are not always legal. But that's half the battle. The most important thing is to find a way to get pregnant.

name: Престиж
summary: Village "Prestige" - a place for the elite. Officials, top managers, opera divas with their families and servants live here. The usual existence of the village is interrupted by the murder of the nanny of the Filimonov family. This makes the neighbors look at each other with suspicion and wonder if those to whom they trust the most precious thing - their children are so perfect. In the course of the investigation, which begins the "queen of the local police" Elizaveta Yegorovna, it becomes clear that absolutely every inhabitant of the "Prestige" has his own secrets and motives for the murder.

name: Убить Риту
summary: A fragile-looking chemistry teacher, Rita, is left without a job because of her connections with a student. But thanks to her skills, she manages to earn easy money cleaning the cottage. True, this cottage turns out to be a crime scene, and Rita herself finds herself at the epicenter of the criminal showdowns of local bandits. However, Rita is not so simple - all this time she lived undercover on someone else's passport. A few years ago, she already had to flee from her native St. Petersburg to a seaside town in order to save her life. After all, Rita is the only living carrier of the formula, which her pursuers really need.

name: Scout's Safari
summary: The show revolves around Jennifer "Scout" Lauer, a teenage girl who lives the simple life in New York City until her photographer father is sent on year-round trip around the world and she is forced to live with her Know-it-all mother and her new husband at a resort in South Africa. While she is there she is exposed to a new world, goes to a new school, and reunites with her other best friend named Bongani, who believes strongly in his Zulu culture, lives with his Uncle C.B., a veterinarian. Bongani is often the voice of reason for Scout. While still keeping in contact with her best friend Sherna via webcam, she has to deal with her stepdad's bratty and Know-it-All young son Tyler. During the course of the series Scout eventually becomes more comfortable in her new surroundings.

name: Дурочка Надя
summary: In the center of the plot of the comedy "Fool Nadia" is a sweet, trusting and sympathetic girl named Nadezhda. She is always ready to help absolutely every person, the heroine will help her neighbor even to the detriment of herself. Sometimes such responsiveness goes sideways to the heroine, but despite the cruelty, cynicism and selfishness of some personalities, Nadia does not stop believing in human kindness and sincerity. One day, the kindness of the heroine attracts the most worthy man ...

name: The Shapies
summary: The Shapies love to sing, dance and have formed a band. They play and sing in a variety of music styles and dream of one day becoming the most popular band in the world.

name: Ye Cheng
summary:
Adapted from the novel "Ye Cheng Fu" (夜城赋) by Xi Ge (熄歌).
Shu Cheng, the daughter of the first aristocratic family of Shu, had to pretend to be a boy in order to hide herself. She wanted to promote the peerless Shen Ye as the oiran of the world, but found that Shen Ye seemed to have multiple identities, and it was difficult to distinguish between enemies and friends. In the center of the turbulent power, the two must work together, and the opposition of identities makes them the closest enemy.

name: My Lethal Man
summary: In a thrilling kidnapping case, Shen Manning meets her "doppelganger" Zhuang Xinyan, and Xinyan's quick death forces Shen Manning to start up her "second life" with the identity of her "fiancé," a powerful and mysterious Yan Xingcheng. Shen Manning is brought by Yan Xingcheng into the whirlpool of the huge changes in the Zhuang family. From being hostile to each other, they start working on things together hand in hand, overcoming all the difficulties to finally reversing the almost-collapse of the Zhuang family. Yan Xingcheng also finally found the truth of a secret case 17 years ago... In the end, the truth of the unresolved case 17 years ago was revealed, and the two of them realized the warm power of true love and family. Yan Xingcheng and Manning join hands and start a new life with love.

name: Call Me Detective Incense
summary: Adapted from the webcomic "Call Me Detective Incense" (在下一炷香) by Amy (阿弥)

name: Jiang Hu Shao Nian Jue
summary:
Adapted from the webnovel "Jiang Hu Shao Nian Jue " (江湖少年诀) by Zi Mo Jian (自磨剑).
The "Shi Wei Map", which records  the burial place of the treasure, appears from nowhere, leading to a lot of turmoil in Jianghu and begins the fight, of various forces, to find it.  Soon,  two bizarre events take place - the disappearance of an opera troupe and piles of bones appearing in the Shangtang River. Detective Su Cheng Xi, constable Sui Han Bai and assassin Zuo Han Qin, starts to get interested in the whole case.  Especially since the mythical map and the bones, seem to be related in a strange way.

name: Families at War
summary: Vic Reeves and Bob Mortimer present the game show in which two opposing family teams carry out unusual challenges.

name: Stock, Aitken and Waterman: Legends of Pop
summary: A look at the career of the songwriting and record production trio consisting of Mike Stock, Matt Aitken, and Pete Waterman, a story of incredible success but also of fractured relationships and court cases.

name: Бедные Абрамовичи
summary:
Four generations of a Jewish family live under one roof in the center of Moscow. And although the Abramovichi live very close to the synagogue, all of them, with the exception of old Musi Lvovna, are very far from Jewish traditions, religion and self-consciousness. Borya sells (and eats) pork, unsuccessfully trying to succeed in business, his son David hides his origin, and his wife Alla does not even suspect how much she looks like a real aidisha mother.

But everything changes one day when a lightning bolt hits Borya, who is running away from the collectors. When he comes to himself, he gets acquainted with the spirit of his ancestor — the harmful old man Chaim. Once Chaim committed a terrible sin and brought a curse on their entire family. Only Borya can remove it from the Abramovich family, but for this it is necessary to free Chaim's soul.

name: R.I.S. Científica
summary: The series follows the team of forensic experts in Spain who are trying to solve crimes with the help of forensic evidence.

name: R.I.S. - Die Sprache der Toten
summary: When normal police work gets stuck, their work begins. The team of "R.I.S." uses the most modern scientific methods to solve murders. They are the best of the best in their field, they understand the language of the dead. And you are the last chance for justice. Criminal prosecution has changed: ever better instruments and methods are available for securing evidence. With technology at the forefront, investigators must hone skills across a wide range of disciplines to make their manhunts, bring down perpetrators of violent crime, and bring justice. For this reason, the Forensic Investigative Special Commission, abbreviated RIS, was founded in Berlin. In it, scientists and police officers go together in search of clues and perpetrators.

name: Cosmic Love France
summary: Cosmic Love is the first dating show based on astrology. With help from the Astrochamber, Nabilla goes to meet 4 single girls, to guide them in their quest for love. Seduction, jealousy, betrayal, passion… the stars are playful and full of surprises for these young single women.

name: Lampje
summary: Lampje, based on the acclaimed book of the same name by Annet Schaap, is the magical story in four parts about the 11-year-old daughter of the lighthouse keeper. Every day when it gets dark she climbs up to turn on the light. On a stormy night everything goes wrong. This is the start of an adventure in which Lampje shows that she can do more than she ever thought possible.

name: Going Fur Gold
summary: Devoted owners and their beloved cats, rabbits, chickens, guinea pigs and alpacas strut their stuff in animal competitions across America.

name: The Big Soirée
summary: Actresses Silvia Abril and Toni Acosta are gifted an epic celebration of their 50th birthdays... but to make it to the big event, they must survive a series of over-the-top adventures, doled out one mystery envelope at a time.

name: Super Duper Sumos
summary: Three crimefighting sumo wrestlers — the brothers Booma, Kimo and Mamoo — go on adventures and fight using their enormous size and gigantic hindquarters.

previousepisode.name: That Was Zen This Is Tao

name: Mary & George
summary: Mary & George is based on the true story of Mary Villiers, Countess of Buckingham, who in 17th century England moulded her beautiful son, George, to seduce King James I and become his all-powerful lover. Through outrageous scheming, the pair rose from humble beginnings to become the richest, most titled, and influential players the English court had ever seen, and the King's most trusted advisors.

name: Power Slap: Road to the Title
summary: Over 30 athletes compete for a spot in the brand new Power Slap league, and a shot at victory in the first title fight.

name: Web of Death
summary: Web of Death, a six-episode docu-series, follows the investigations of online sleuths as they use digital footprints, DNA databases and the power of social media to solve gruesome, mysterious and bizarre murder cases.

name: Problem Spaces
summary: Houston-based DIY designer Fariha Nasir takes difficult spaces -- odd-angled walls, outdated designs and areas that just aren't working -- and turns them into her clients' favorite rooms.

name: The Shoufu Can Read Mind
summary: The food blogger Shen Zhi Huan traversed into the body of Shen Zhi Huan, the nominal wife of Xu Yan Qing, the Senior Grand Secretary of Sui Dynasty. As she was aware that this notorious official would not end well, she tried to get divorce. Little did she know that he gained the ability to hear her minds so that he knew her every scheme and became interested in her.

name: Large Queen
summary: Su Jinxia, the daughter of the Great General, was appointed as the Empress consort of the sickly old Emperor. Unfortunately, on the wedding day, the old Emperor passed away. Upon hearing the news that she was to be buried together with the old Emperor, Su Jinxia collapsed. Her body was then taken over by the soul of a fashion designer from modern times. This new Su Jinxia was different from the original one. She was bold and cheerful. The new Emperor spared her from the sacrificial burial as long as she was willing to marry him. So she became the Empress consort of the new Emperor. Unaware of the Emperor's true love, Su Jinxia eventually ran away from the palace. When this plump Empress consort learned that fat women were considered low in status and bullied outside, she decided to open a plus-size clothing store. Soon, the Emperor appeared to pursue his love.

name: Along with Me
summary: This tells the story of two young lion dancers who grew up together, "Lion Head–Luo Xingxing" and "Lion Tail–He Yangguang." However, as time passes, due to changes in the Luo family, and the He family emigrating, they have never met since. Many years later, Luo Xingxing, who had changed his name, came to Singapore as part of Tianfu University for an exchange to Wiley University. Here, he happened to meet with the He Yangguang, who took the opportunity to return to China to look for Luo Xingxing. where they finally met at the entrance of the old street; and at this time, looking at Luo Xingxing, who is deep in debt and taking care of his grandmother alone, He Yangguang had so many questions to ask. After the success of their small business, "Little Lion" and the death of Grandma Luo from her illness, they finally untie each other's hearts and, like "Little Lion," face loss bravely and face life positively.

name: Mother and Son
summary: When his widowed mum, Maggie, sets fire to the kitchen, recently single Arthur Gbeme moves back into the family home. As he tells it, he has "put his life on hold" to care for his mum, but the truth is, there isn't much to put on hold. A former nurse, Maggie used to be a firebrand – a renegade. But since the death of her husband, Maggie has been… a little off.

name: When Is the Son off
summary:
Adapted from the web novel "Gong Zi He Shi Xiu" (公子何时休).
It tells the touching story of heroine Yu Xin Huan in the VR game "When Will The Son Go Off", who is unyielding and brave to fight against evil forces, thus gaining true love.

name: Deep Fake: Neighbour Wars
summary:
Deep Fake: Neighbour Wars uses the latest AI technology to make the UK's best new impressionists become the world's most famous celebrities. And they're all arguing.

Loved up Nicki Minaj and Tom Holland vs Mark Zuckerberg, Billie Eilish and Taekwondo teacher Beyonce, Mark Wahlberg and wannabe strongman Chris Rock. Some of the celebrities, all embroiled in petty silly neighbour disputes.

name: Vigilante
summary: Vigilante tells the story of the journey of a young man bent on seeking revenge after witnessing his mother's brutal murder as a child. Since the traumatic event, Kim Ji Yong has dedicated himself to martial arts, becoming an exemplary student at the police academy. Upon his mother's attacker's release, Ji Yong catches him in the midst of another assault, setting him on a path of taking justice into his own hands, garnering unwelcome attention from the media and police.  Refusing to give up his mission, Jiyong finds himself assuming the role of a vigilante, correcting the wrongs of repeat offenders.

name: Queenmaker
summary: Strategy. Influence. Corruption. An unlikely pair of accomplished women joins forces to go up against a powerful conglomerate for the mayorship of Seoul.

name: Mask Girl
summary: An office worker who is insecure about her looks becomes a masked internet personality by night --- until a chain of ill-

name: Count Abdulla
summary: Count Abdulla follows Abdulla Khan - a mid-twenties British-Pakistani Muslim doctor stuck in an identity crisis, caught between his religious mother and his secular, hedonistic friends. But when Abdulla is bitten by a vampire he suddenly becomes the outsider's outsider.

name: Ruby Speaking
summary: Ruby Speaking follows Ruby's misadventures working in a call centre. Ruby is a popular addition to the workforce but puts other people's problems above her own and definitely above making a sale.

name: Significant Other
summary: Significant Other follows two lonely neighbours who embark on a hesitant, obstacle-filled relationship after drastic life events bring them together.  As this strange love story unfolds with wryly observed wit and warmth, could these deeply flawed individuals – both at a time in their lives when change is difficult and rarely expected – influence each other for the better?

name: Significant Other
summary: Two lonely neighbors in their late 40's – a single woman and a newly divorced man -  find themselves living next door to each other and embark on a hesitant, obstacle-filled relationship.

name: De Stamhouder
summary: When 25-year-old Alexander falls in love with the free-spirited Ellen, she confronts him with his family's suppressed war past. The poignant, sometimes desperate search for understanding and reconciliation with his father and long-lost mother begins...

name: Todas las veces que nos enamoramos
summary: Ever since they met, Irene and Julio have been falling in love, splitting up, and then trying again. Will they ever find their happy ending?

name: Why Try to Change Me Now
summary:
Adapted from the novel "Moses on the Plain" (平原上的摩西) by Shuang Xue Tao (双雪涛). 
Set in China's hardscrabble, industrial northeast, it tells the story of a young police officer investigating the murder of a taxi driver, only to find a childhood friend may be involved. To solve the case, he explores layer by layer, revealing a past buried 12 years ago.

name: Cristo y Rey
summary: Madrid, 1979. Ángel Cristo is the best trainer in the world. Bárbara Rey, actress and muse of uncovering, the most desired woman in Spain. From the moment they meet until they announce their marriage, only a few weeks pass. It's the wedding of the year and the news is on the covers of all the magazines. The Circus of Bárbara Rey and Ángel Cristo becomes the fashion show; a million-dollar business. Money, fame, luxury... Nine years of relationship in which Spain witnessed the couple's happiness: the birth of Angelito and Sofía, the purchase of sports cars, jewelry, an ostentatious chalet in La Moraleja... Far from the flashes, However, there is hidden an escalation of drug addiction, gambling, infidelities and abuse... And, in the background, the shadow of Bárbara's relationship with a powerful statesman.

previousepisode.name: La única fiera que no pude domar

name: Torpet
summary: I den småländska skogen bortom farmens räckhåll finns Torpet, där vi återser gamla och nya favoriter från årets säsong av Farmen. Här finns ingen storbonde men det gäller ändå att kämpa för sin överlevnad och att ta sig igenom Torpets utmaningar.

name: Padeldrömmar
summary: It folllows Fabian and Hasse who have a badminton hall. They feel quite unsuccessful and tired of where they are in life, and they get an idea that can change everything: padel.

name: Paradise
summary: Tone Sekelius invites you to a new house, and a new Paradise with completely new game rules that will change everything. Who can you really trust when everything is at stake?

name: Seishun Cinderella
summary: Hagino Shion is a 29-year-old beauty consultant. Although she has never had a boyfriend, Shion leads a happy and fulfilling life. However, one day, Shion participates in a blind date party and it triggers a flashback where she was rejected by her first love back in high school, who told her, "If you're going to confess, you should at least do something about your appearance". As if drawn back by her past trauma, Shion somehow goes back in time and becomes a 17-year-old high school student again. Using the makeup techniques she has honed, Shion decides to move towards a different timeline as compared to what happened 12 years ago.

name: Marko & Irma
summary: We follow the artist Markoolio and his mother Irma in their everyday life. When it turns out that Irma's cottage on Ingarö in the Stockholm archipelago, (which Marko bought for her so that she would be free from alcohol) is moldy, they decide to build a new one. It will be a house-builder's journey edged by their Finnish hot temper, but also a lot of laughter, pranks and unexpected meetings on the construction site.

previousepisode.name: Hur ska han klara sig utan mig?

name: 30 Minuter
summary: Interview program where Anders Holmberg seeks answers and goes in depth with a current holder of power.

name: DAM
summary: In this chilling psychological thriller, Yola returns to the Eastern Cape farmhouse of her childhood after her father's death. Spirits in the house start tormenting her - or is the haunting only in her head?

name: The Girl He Never Noticed
summary: Faced with terrible financial circumstances, Jade gets a job as a personal secretary to the son of the richest shipping magnate, Eros, but things get complicated when, in a desperate attempt to secure a suitable heir to the company, Eros asks Jade to become his fake bride! Will they be able to keep their "relationship" strictly professional? Meanwhile, Eros finds Jade strangely familiar, but he can't figure out what's going on...

previousepisode.name: You and Me Against the World

name: America Express
summary: America Express is the Romanian version of the reality show Peking Express which was created in 2004.

name: extremistas.br
summary: Over eight episodes, themes such as armamentism, denialism, religion and the manipulation of morals and good customs will emerge before viewers. The series explains how these factors led thousands of people to spread coup speeches, as has been happening at the door of barracks since Lula's election.

name: Yellowstone Wardens
summary: Discover the lives of conservation officers of Montana defending public lands, handling anti-poaching sting operations, and more.

name: Go and Domain Your Game
summary:
Adapted from the manhua "It Starts With A Mountain" (开局一座山) by VV.
The story is about university student Cheng Da Lei who accidentally transmigrates into a video game.

name: A Portrait of Jianghu: Reincarnated Disciple
summary: The story took place in two parallel universes named Yuan and Yi, where people shared the same life and death. Nian Yangxiao, came from the Yuan World to save his true love Kong Linghui, crossed the border to the Yi World in search of the killer who assassinated his love. In the Yi World, however, he and Kong Linghui were enemies. Kong Linghui tried everything to kill him. At the same time, the mysterious girl Yong'er, the romantic street gangster, the cold-faced police officer Nuo Dun and others appeared one after another, each accompanied with a complex case. The involvement of Nian Yangxiao made the cases more complicated and confusing. A suspenseful, thrilling, blood-burning and fantastic adventure in different time and space was launched in "A Portrait of Jianghu: Double Life".

name: Rising Lady
summary: The story centers around the three ladies, the career elite Lei Li, the full-time wife Ren Duo Mei, and the socially adorable Shen Jia Nan are facing dilemma in the workplace and life. They are of different ages and personalities, and has no overlapping experiences, but became close friends who knew each other, fight each other and loved each other. Together, they face optimistically amidst the thorns along the way, witnessing each other growth, and join hands to embark on a new journey to find happiness.

name: Mi Xiao Quan going to school
summary: Adapted from series of child novels "Mi Xiao Quan Shang Xue Ji" (米小圈上学记) by Beicat.

name: Celebrity
summary: Fame. Money. Power. One young woman fights to become the next hottest celebrity in the glamorous yet scandalous world of influencers in Seoul.

name: The Legend of An Le
summary:
A heart-wrenching tale between Ren An Le, the sole survivor of a clan falsely accused of treason against the imperial family and Crown Prince Han Ye who has fallen for her.

Di Ziyuan is a righteous woman who cares for the common people. A descendant of the founding fathers of the nation, she loses everything and everyone she loves due to unforeseen events. Unwilling to be shackled by fate, she takes the name Ren Anle and decides to do what she can to help the victims of war. While she aspires to restore peace in the land, she also conducts her own investigation to clear her family's name.

Due to her virtuous acts, the people have come to hold Ren Anle in high esteem. She also wins the admiration of Crown Prince Han Ye. She assists Han Ye in exposing rampant fraud at the imperial exams and corruption across disaster relief operations in Jiangnan. When war erupts along the borders. Ren Anle decides to follow Han Ye to war. Han Ye ultimately helps Ren Anle uncover the truth to right the wrongs from the past.

name: Wong & Winchester
summary: Wong & Winchester is about an ex-cop turned private eye, Marissa Wong, who ends up being forced to work with Sarah Winchester, an inexperienced young woman fresh out of university.

name: Song of the Bandits
summary: In the lawless land of Gando, fierce bandits will stop at nothing to fight for their precious homeland and loved ones — even if it means life or death. This Korean Western drama stars Kim Nam-gil, Seohyun, Yoo Jae-myung, Lee Hyun-wook and Lee Ho-jung.

name: Murdaugh Murders: A Southern Scandal
summary: Shocking tragedies shatter a tight-knit South Carolina community and expose the horrifying secrets of its most powerful family.

name: Сеструха
summary: The owner of a popular metropolitan club is suddenly imprisoned. The brother instructs his sister, a prison guard from the outback, with whom he has not communicated for many years, to save the business from imminent loss. A simple Russian woman, far from the fashionable life of the capital, will have to level the affairs of the club and cope with the world of Moscow glamour.

name: Lois & Varga
summary: A newly-married couple moves to a small and vaunted island after inheriting a heavenly parcel of oceanfront property. But once they arrive, they meet Varga, the island's only stripper and yoga teacher, who begins to sinisterly unravel their lives.

name: My Heart Is Beating
summary: A romance drama about a semi-human vampire named Sun Woo Hyul, who failed to become a human by a day out of 100 years, and a woman Joo In Hae, who doesn't have a single human decency, starting to live together and finding true warmth.

name: Behind Your Touch
summary: Ye Boon, who has always dreamed of becoming a vet in the small town of Mujin in Chungjeong-do, is instead stuck doing the nitty-gritty work to make ends meet, like delivering calves and vaccinating halibuts. Then one day, she was given psychometric powers during one of her visits to a cow farm. She encounters the passionate detective Jang Yul, who mistakes her for a pervert and attempts to tackle her. Subsequently, Jang Yul relies on Ye Boon and her powers to solve his cases, from petty crimes to serial murder. The two grow closer as they solve each case, one by one.

name: Doona!
summary: A college student navigates life and school while dealing with a unique predicament — he's living with a beautiful former K-pop sensation.
